species.name: Crappie
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–26 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

Northwest wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
